completeness.reason: Extremely comprehensive. Covers the full Value class API (all constructors, type predicates, conversions, array/object operations, iterators, comparisons, comments, bool operator), Reader and CharReaderBuilder with settings, StreamWriterBuilder, FastWriter, StyledWriter, StyledStreamWriter, free utility functions, and stream operators. File layout specified. All ValueType enum values listed.

unambiguity.reason: Nearly all interfaces are precisely defined with signatures and semantics. The CharReaderBuilder settings (allowComments, allowTrailingCommas, etc.) are enumerated. Some minor ambiguities: what asXxx() does on type mismatch, and what insert/removeIndex return on out-of-bounds. The explicit bool conversion rule ('false for null and empty collections, true otherwise') is clearly stated.

testability.reason: Blackbox tests cover construction, type checking, array/object operations, iterator usage, parsing and writer output — all derivable from the prompt. The asString() conversion for numeric types (returns '42', 'true', 'false', '') and null->'' semantic are stated and testable. The Reader.good() method and structured errors are specified.

consistency.reason: Verified against blackbox test includes (json/json.h) and test operations. The test uses Json::Value(Json::arrayValue), Json::Value(Json::objectValue), isNull(), asInt(), append(), getMemberNames() — all exactly as specified. The ValueType enum names (nullValue, intValue, uintValue, realValue, etc.) match the prompt.
